description: Goal: keep the epic CI warning-free on supported GitHub Actions runtimes. Signal: successful CI run 33970075487 emitted a controlled annotation that actions/upload-artifact@v4 targets deprecated Node.js 20 and is being forced onto Node.js 24. Strategy: after the recalculator arc is otherwise complete, select the supported official upload-artifact release, preserve the current coverage artifact name/path/retention and failure behavior, and prove the workflow uploads the same artifact without the deprecation annotation. Acceptance: workflow syntax is valid; lint, audit, docs, full llvm-cov test step, and artifact upload pass; the run has no controlled Node-runtime deprecation warning; documentation is updated only if the operator contract changes. Do not suppress the warning or remove coverage artifacts.
title: Remove the CI upload-artifact Node 20 deprecation
